pr.title: Retry a failed request on a server error
pr.head: retry-5xx
pr.gist: A request that fails with a server error is tried again, as many times as the config says.

src/client.ts.title: Retry once a server error comes back
src/client.ts.why: A 5xx is often transient; a 4xx is not.

hints.text: only one retry, whatever retries says

gaps.title: A 404 is not tried again
gaps.recommendation: Add the 4xx case beside the 503 one.

comments.title: Only one retry
comments.body: retries is read as a yes or no: any count above zero retries exactly once.
comments.recommendation: Loop up to retries times, or rename the setting to say it is a switch.
